description: Champions have no autonomy; all security decisions in their teams are made exclusively by a central security team.
Champions are occasionally consulted but rarely given real decision-making authority over their team's security practices.
Champions are trusted to make day-to-day security decisions within their teams, with light oversight.
Champions are consistently trusted as the go-to security experts for their teams, with the central security team acting as a support function.
Champions are fully empowered as embedded security experts, trusted to represent and act on their team's security needs, with the organization systematically acting on their input.
